# moyo (vendored)

`moyo_wasm.js` and `moyo_wasm_bg.wasm` are the WebAssembly build of [moyo](https://github.com/spglib/moyo), the
crystal-symmetry library from the spglib developers, copied unchanged from the npm package `@spglib/moyo-wasm` 0.22.0
(`moyo_wasm_bg.wasm` sha256 `ea2a7958b5f5864d692293fd794613b8e32c4e645c3b8c2e5d86da9421c514c2`).
isoview's worker loads it on first use to name the space group of the shown structure.
